name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives your AI coding assistant a memory, so it remembers what it learned about your project between sessions instead of starting from zero every time.
buyer: An indie developer or small engineering team running Claude Code daily across multi-week projects, losing time re-explaining project context every new session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer working on a long-running SaaS product avoids re-explaining architecture decisions to their AI assistant every session, saving real billable time.
A dev agency standardizes it across client projects so any team member's AI session picks up full project history and decisions instantly.
A technical consultant offers a 'persistent AI pairing setup' service, configuring this plus related tooling for client teams.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed memory service for teams who don't want to self-host, billed per seat.
Sell a one-off setup and tuning service for teams adopting it across an existing large codebase.

steal_this: This weekend, install it on your own longest-running project, measure how much re-explaining time it saves in a week, and use that number to pitch a setup service to other teams.
